title: One 365
notes: Official variant pages read 2026-11-01 (tube type, RaceGuard, ADDIX 4-Season, black with reflective strip, EUR 54.90 RRP): 11654445 25-622 300 g, max 9 bar/130 psi; 11654444 28-622 320 g, 8 bar/115 psi; 11654443 32-622 355 g, 6.5 bar/95 psi. 'The all-season road bike tire'; 'Plenty of grip even at low temperatures, good rolling resistance at all temperatures'; 'Replaces training and commuting tire Durano DD'. No explicit wet-grip claim.
